pet_notes: Recognizable chibi BB: lavender bob-cut hair and purple eyes; huge red side ribbon; white blouse with red ribbon tie; black-purple high-collared dress with flared cape-like sleeves and coat tails; thigh-high dark boots; tiny cyan Moon Cell-style sleeve accent without readable logo or text. Vibrant, mischievous, excited AI kouhai energy. Signature motion mapping: idle includes an unmistakable wink; waving is a cheerful salute-to-wave; jumping is arms-up rejoicing; waiting requests senpai approval with tongue out and a clear finger peace sign; failed is flustered disbelief before correcting herself. Preserve compact full-body silhouette and large readable facial expressions.
